verdict.rationale: OpenAI documents first-class SDK support: official SDKs, including the Python library on GitHub, plus a dedicated Agents SDK for orchestration and a managed Codex harness for building agents. Skills, remote MCP servers and Plugins are also documented, and community users report plugging GPT into Codex and custom harnesses. Missing for 10: documented official integrations with third-party agent frameworks or coding agents, and in-depth docs on Skills/Plugins beyond one-line mentions.
